name: diffish
description: Explorable file-level dependency graph for JS/TS repositories

scripts.build: pnpm esbuild src/main.ts src/preload.ts src/scan.ts src/git.ts src/subgraph.ts src/functions.ts src/diff.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --outdir=dist && pnpm esbuild src/renderer.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer.js && cp src/index.html dist/ && pnpm css
scripts.css: cat node_modules/daisyui/base/reset.css node_modules/daisyui/base/properties.css node_modules/daisyui/base/svg.css node_modules/daisyui/theme/winter.css node_modules/daisyui/components/button.css node_modules/daisyui/components/select.css node_modules/daisyui/components/input.css node_modules/daisyui/components/table.css node_modules/daisyui/components/badge.css node_modules/daisyui/components/card.css node_modules/daisyui/components/divider.css node_modules/daisyui/components/menu.css node_modules/daisyui/components/alert.css src/app.css > dist/app.css
